The video helped normalize a then-novel format: the promotional clip as candid tour diary rather than staged performance, foreshadowing the MTV-era 'behind the scenes' aesthetic.

OMD8hBsA-RI.sig: A landmark in the arena rock power ballad video format, 'Faithfully' helped establish the documentary-style music video as a legitimate promotional vehicle. Its influence can be traced through subsequent 'life on the road' rock videos of the mid-to-late 1980s.

h3Qq1S0JxVw.context: Released October 27, 2023, 'Touchdown' arrives at the apex of Calabasas's major-label ascent, serving as the debut single for the Los Angeles duo on Def Jam Recordings.
